response.descriptionNullable:
📄 Dataset Description & Disclaimer:
This dataset was created by scraping publicly available real estate listings from Guland.vn. It is intended solely for educational and research purposes.

I do not claim ownership of the original data. All rights remain with the respective platform and content owners.
If you are the data owner and wish for this dataset to be removed, please contact me.

📁 Files Included:
VN-real-estate-Apr-Sept-2025.csv -
This is the main and recently-updated file for analysis. It contains structured and cleaned data with the following types of variables:
- Location (province, district, ward)
- Property features (area, number of floors, bedrooms, legal status, etc.)
- Listing details (title, description, posting date)
- Target variable: price (in billion VND) and price per m²
- Engineered features for predictive modeling

Some columns are in Vietnamese and translatable to English (except for paragraphs), try the translating notebook at https://www.kaggle.com/code/qmanhbeo/translate-vn-real-estate-datasets-to-english

This file has been tested in a housing price prediction model using XGBoost, achieving 83% R² accuracy.
